name: Hezekiah
overview: Hezekiah was a male figure in biblical history known primarily as the great-great-grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah. Scripture provides limited details about his tribe or other personal notes, focusing instead on his genealogical significance as recorded in Zephaniah 1:1.
namesAndTitles: The name Hezekiah means 'y-h-v-h is [my] strength,' reflecting a declaration of reliance on the Lord. This proper name, noted in Zephaniah 1:1, highlights a key aspect of his identity centered on God's strength rather than being a name given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Hezekiah is recorded as the father of Amariah according to Zephaniah 1:1. Beyond this, Scripture does not detail further family relationships apart from his connection to Zephaniah as a great-great-grandfather.
scriptureSignificance: Hezekiah holds an important place in the biblical lineage as an ancestor of the prophet Zephaniah, linking him to the prophetic tradition. His historical role as a righteous king who led spiritual reforms and trusted God in times of crisis demonstrates a life marked by faith and devotion. His example encourages trust in God's power and faithfulness, especially in moments of national peril and personal trial.
